# WO-610: Install a local broker list into a data folder from the CLI; private file mode
Status: queued (in-house, contract)
Vendor: claude
Agent: orchestrator
Owner: orchestrator (contract)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Kind: engine
Severity: LOW
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner real-data test, stage 1 (search only), qa-security 2026-11-11. Private results are kept outside the repo; this WO is PII-free by rule.

## Goal
To point a test data folder at the full private registry, qa had to call `registry.install_family_registry()` from Python: `config set registry_url` needs https on the allowlist (`registry.py:179-183`), the private repo is not reachable anonymously, and there is no `registry install FILE` command. Developers running from a git worktree also fall back to the 31-broker sample silently, because the gitignored `brokers/registry.yaml` lives only in the main checkout (`registry.py:54-56`). Separately, `install_registry_bytes` wrote `FREEMYID_HOME/registry.yaml` with mode 0644 inside the 0700 folder; the private list should be 0600 like every other file there.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `freemyid registry install FILE` validates (same checks as an update) and installs into the active data folder; prints source/version/count; refuses files over the size cap.
2. The cached registry is written 0600 (POSIX); test asserts the mode.
3. `doctor` adds a hint when running from a source checkout that has no full registry ("sample list: run registry install <path> for the full list").
4. Tests: valid file installs; invalid file leaves the old one in place; mode check.

## Allowed paths
- `src/freemyid/cli.py`
- `src/freemyid/registry.py`
- `src/freemyid/doctor.py`
- `docs/CLI.md`
- `tests/test_registry_install.py` (new)

Registry content; the update feed.
